outcome: maternal pain relief (Visual Analogue Scale - VAS)
frequency of operative or instrumental deliveries
cohort: The study included 100 parturient women who received epidural analgesia (cases) and 100 parturient women who did not (controls) during labour at a hospital.
finding: The study observed a significant decrease in pain relief with epidural analgesia, and found no increase in instrumental deliveries or caesarean sections.
mod_finding: There was no evidence of an increase in the incidence of instrumental deliveries or caesarean sections in patients who received epidural analgesia.
